# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Developer Preview scope

- [ ] The change remains within the documented Developer Preview.
- [ ] It does not claim or enable Mainnet, Token Trading, Marketplace, Custody,
      or Real Payment Finality.
- [ ] Compatibility and documentation impacts are described.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results.

## Security and release hygiene

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private keys, cloud credentials, Verifier secrets,
      or Settlement secrets are included.
- [ ] No generated build output or release Artifact is committed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive reports use the private process in SECURITY.md.
